# `list_door_groups`

List every door group defined on the controller.

Side effects: None (read-only).

Door groups bundle doors for access-policy assignment. Returns
``id``, ``name``, ``door_ids``, and ``description``.

## Example

```python
list_door_groups(controller="default")
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `controller` | `string` | no | "default" | Name of the UniFi controller to target. |
